reason: base.rb:241 `File.extname(filename).tr('.', '')` — `tr` is a String instance method. JS strings have none, so activesupport exposes it as the free function `tr(type, ".", "")`. Receiver-as-first-argument, not an extra argument.

base.rb:35 `entry.nil?` — Ruby `nil?` is an ordinary method any object may override (base.ts:216-226 documents the two receivers that do), so trails renders it as the free function `isNil(entry)`. Receiver-as-first-argument.
